title: The Owl Pellet of Gentle Facts
youtube_title: The Owl Pellet of Gentle Facts | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Paz finds an owl pellet the library had in a labeled box, only to look at. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Paz shows Dahlia how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
